title: Multi-key device sort
hints: sorted(devices, key=f) where f returns a tuple: tuples compare element by element, so (os, ..., name) gives you the tie-breaking for free.
A date cannot be negated, but d["last_seen"].toordinal() is an int and -that sorts newest first. Guard the None case before calling it.
Put a boolean before the date: (d["os"], seen is None, -seen.toordinal() if seen else 0, d["name"]). False sorts before True, so real dates come first and None last.
